name: api-badge
title: ApiBadge
description: Signature shield: protocol or metric on the left, name and version or a proof on the right. The ARAZZO variant is inverted and never borrows a protocol color.

a11y.pattern: Static inline element; the visible text is the accessible name
aria: No role="img" override: the text is read as "REST API Pastry 2.0" or "ARAZZO restock-pastry"
Proof status fills add an icon and a visually hidden status word
a11y.notes: Protocol is always written as text in the badge; the color only speeds up scanning.
